title: America Built About 900 Car Washes in a Year #shorts
summary: About 850-900 new car washes opened in the US in 2023 (industry estimate). In February 2025 Zips, with about 260 locations, filed for Chapter 11.
sources: Industry estimate (equipment maker Sonny's, via Professional Carwashing & Detailing, 2025 State of the Carwash Market): "around 850-900 new stores in 2023", now about 550 a year (plus or minus 100), over 90% express tunnels: https://www.carwash.com/2025-state-of-the-carwash-market/

Express tunnel construction "$5 to $8 million", land often more than $1 million (Star Tribune, Jan 2025): https://www.startribune.com/car-wash-subscription-private-equity-boom-everywhere-drive-thru-tunnel/601209808
Zips Car Wash files Chapter 11, "operating approximately 260 locations across 23 states" (Business Wire, Feb 5, 2025): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250205641535/en

scenes.narration: America built roughly {900|nine hundred} car washes in one year. Then a big chain went bankrupt.
Investors loved the monthly memberships, so tunnels went up at {5 to 8 million dollars|five to eight million dollars} each.
In {2025,|twenty twenty-five,} Zips, with about {260|two hundred sixty} locations, filed for bankruptcy.
Steady members can't pay for unlimited tunnels.
